lines.en: I walk on two legs, shoulders forward

lines.zh: 我身上的黑色纹路在动
lines.en: The black markings on me shift
My foot leaves a shallow pit
I take the mountain path up
I brace on the rock
I walk toward where my tamer stands
I watch the valley as I walk

lines.zh: 手臂垂得很低，几乎扫地。
lines.en: My arms hang so low they nearly sweep the floor.

lines.zh: 我踩平碎石，给你让出条道。
lines.en: I tread the gravel flat and clear a path.
I cross the scree, each footstep heavy.

lines.zh: 风里有黑暗数码鱼的味道。
lines.en: The wind carries dark digifish scent.
I turn and gravel slides
I come to stand beside you
My tail drags across the rubble
I crouch with my arms on my knees

lines.zh: 黑古拉兽的鼻孔，喷着热气。
lines.en: BlackGrowmon's nostrils vent hot air.
I watch what moves below
I flex my fingers
There's grit on my hide
I wait for you to call me
Wind passes over my spine
I close my eyes by inches
I sit by the anchor
There's a lot of stone here
I tap the cliff with a claw
I glance up at the clouds
I rub the back of my hand on the cliff
I stretch my legs out and draw them back
I stoop my head to look at you
You're a head shorter

lines.zh: 你身上的味儿我认得出
lines.en: I can tell your scent
Don't stand directly in front of me

lines.zh: 我的爪心朝上，等你放东西。
lines.en: My palm faces up, waiting for you to place something.
You step back and I stop
Your hand is on my claw
It's been a long while since this
Do you want me to follow

lines.zh: 我低下头，把角让开你的手。
lines.en: I lower my head, moving my horn from your hand.
Let's walk together
My flame comes out black.
I crouch so we can talk

lines.zh: 你不必怕，我是被养大的。
lines.en: Do not fear; I was raised tame.
I'm not the least bit hurried

lines.zh: 你回头看时，我的尾巴还在。
lines.en: When you look back, my tail is still there.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，脚下碎石响
lines.en: I step back onto rattling gravel
A growl rolls out of my chest

lines.zh: 我甩甩手臂，爪子还举着。
lines.en: I shake my arm; my claws stay up.
A gash crosses my markings
I set my feet again
I sink my weight lower
I'll hold that one in mind
I glare at it without blinking
I'm still on the path
I can still move
That meat in your hand
I can smell blood
I won't snatch; I'll wait it out

lines.zh: 那块鱼肉，比数码鱼新鲜。
lines.en: That fish flesh is fresher than a digifish.
That's exactly one mouthful
I eat it down to nothing
Just how much is there
Move your hand back a little
I eat meat, nothing else
I run my tongue over my teeth
That tastes very good
It's all finished

lines.zh: 你整个人撞在我小腿上
lines.en: You run straight into my shin
I slide back half a pace
You pass under my arm
We both hit the cliff
I shoulder you aside
Rubble falls from above
You stepped on my claw
I pull my claw back
I clear the path
That didn't even break skin
There's another on the mountain path
Its markings are broader than mine
We stand and look at each other
It offers a claw
We both crouch down

lines.zh: 它的呼吸和我的差不多
lines.en: Its breathing matches mine
We look at the same valley
Neither of us moved

lines.zh: 主人一到，我们一起起身
lines.en: The tamer comes and we rise as one
Down the mountain together
I pick it up in one claw
This stone is warm

lines.zh: 这块黑石，牙印都留不下。
lines.en: Not even a tooth print on this black stone.
I lay it by my tamer's boots
It slips through my claws
I bury it in the rubble
This doesn't look like food
I cup it in both hands
I could throw this at something
This one I'm keeping for myself
Something's below on the path

lines.zh: 爪子张开了，火焰在后面。
lines.en: Claws open. Flame behind them.
I stretch my body across the mountain path.
I growl at it, low in the throat
It doesn't give way

lines.zh: 我这一身力气不是白长的
lines.en: This strength isn't for nothing
I settle my weight onto my feet
Get behind me
Then I move first
It's quicker, but lighter
I read where it lands

lines.zh: 我低声吼了一下，向前冲。
lines.en: I give a low roar and charge.
I bear down step by step
Gravel rolls under my feet
It circles and I turn
I slash the air
It retreats to the ridge; I stop.
I hold this stretch of path
My breathing hasn't broken at all
It's looking for a way out

lines.zh: 黑色数码鱼的味道，我记着。
lines.en: I remember black digi-fish.
I close one more step
Now is the right moment to move
It has nowhere to go
I bring a claw down
This fist lands on its shoulder
My fist follows
It's driven to its knees
I shoulder it aside

lines.zh: 这一下打偏了，石头碎了一片
lines.en: I miss and shatter the stone
It bites my arm
I shake it off in one go
I strike from above
It rolls down the path

lines.zh: 我从牙缝里换了一口气
lines.en: I pull a breath through my teeth
I've another round in me

lines.zh: 山道上多了一个高的影子
lines.en: A tall shape appears on the path
I step out from behind the cliff
Rubble slides under my feet
I scent the wind first
I take the narrow point of the path
Sunlight picks out my markings
The black scales on the mountain are mine.
Strong wind here; good for standing

lines.zh: 山地的风把我的鳞吹得发亮。
lines.en: Mountain wind shines my scales.
I'm here for you to speak first

lines.zh: 我一步一步走上这条道
lines.en: I walk up onto this path
A big shadow stands by the path
My black markings shift
I stop and take you in

lines.zh: 火燎在我身上，我拍了拍
lines.en: Fire catches me and I slap it out

lines.zh: 我摔在碎石上，滚了几圈
lines.en: I fall on the rubble and roll
Water fills my nose

lines.zh: 爆风把碎石掀了我一身
lines.en: The blast throws rubble all over me
An arrow sticks in my arm

lines.zh: 那股力量让我的纹路发亮
lines.en: That force lights up my markings
There's no meat in these mountains

lines.zh: 雷打在我身上，我半跪下去
lines.en: Lightning hits me and I drop to one knee
No path below; my claws find nothing
